decision_rationale: Operador individual sem entidade corporativa; ausência de licença explícita de revenda/sublicenciamento; termos vagos sobre uso comercial; risco alto de violação por 'fraudulent/abusive activity' em modelo de reselling não autorizado.

free_tier_limits.premium_features: wildcard, stealth flags, +50 subdomains only on paid plan

risks: No explicit resell or sublicense permission in AUP
Operator is individual with no corporate entity or SLA
Commercial use terms are vague; reselling could be deemed abusive
Unilateral modification of terms without notice
Password sharing prohibited; account-level access cannot be delegated
